UI's repo list shows.

know that from the working directory / git remote.

tools.name: get_generated_prompt
tools.description:
Return a meta-prompt for writing tests for the function.

Cache hits return immediately. Cache misses enqueue a fresh
generation and poll the row for up to ``wait_seconds``. On
timeout the agent gets the ``generation_id`` and can call
``wait_for_prompt`` to keep waiting.

tools.name: get_bulk_prompt
tools.description:
Return a single meta-prompt covering many items in an analysis.

``scope`` selects which slice to aggregate:
  - ``untested`` — all functions with no tests yet
  - ``partial`` — all functions only partially covered
  - ``failing`` — all failing tests
  - ``everything`` — failing tests plus all untes

tools.name: wait_for_prompt
tools.description:
Poll a prompt generation row until it transitions to completed
or failed, or until the timeout. The companion to
``get_generated_prompt`` — call this if the first call returned
``status: pending``.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_done, docs, verify_ui · Private data: check_done, setup, docs, get_baseline_prompt, upload_local_coverage, verify_ui · Public sink: check_done, upload_local_coverage · Destructive: check_done, setup, get_baseline_prompt, upload_local_coverage, clear_manual_coverage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_done, docs, verify_ui · Private data: check_done, setup, docs, get_baseline_prompt, upload_local_coverage, verify_ui · Public sink: check_done, upload_local_coverage · Destructive: check_done, setup, get_baseline_prompt, upload_local_coverage, clear_manual_coverage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
